about: Records superseded by a later corrected run. Hand-curated; lab.reindex() reads it. A superseded record moves to the Archive group on the site and its replacement is listed in the original's unit. Nothing is deleted: record pages, data and research notes stay at their addresses. Add an entry only when the ORIGINAL RUN was faulty (bug, wrong settings), not when a later run merely adds a control or a wider capture. by = null means no corrected run exists.
